$comment: Application-owned content assets, registered for ASSET004. Centrally owned
assets (fonts, product marks, DS components) come from @nanisoft/prism-ui
and its manifest (@nanisoft/prism-ui/assets/manifest.json); this file lists
only what this repository authors. Every entry names its file or component,
its variant/role, its intrinsic size where raster, and its budget. An entry
with `exception` is a governed svg-component: registered, sanitized by
ASSET007, and theme-aware through tokens/currentColor rather than fixed hex.
User-uploaded / external images are not committed here; they must use DSImage
with variant + width/height and pass validateRasterSize (ASSET013).

assets.exception: Brand convergence mark. DSLogo takes an image src; this mark is a theme-aware svg-component (chart tokens + currentColor) so a pack/mode cascade repaints it. Registered here per Mission 9 for complex SVG assets; sanitized by ASSET007 (no script/foreignObject/handlers).

Editorial schematic (1200x675 viewBox, asset-defined ratio). Decorative (aria-hidden); MediaBand01 caption carries meaning. Migrating to DSIllustration needs the drawing emitted as a static .svg file upstream; requested as DS capability, see docs/UI_GOVERNANCE.md.

Interactive constellation: orbit SVG plus five ProductMark links. Not a static image; it is domain composition of DS ProductMark components. The orbit SVG is the registered complex-diagram asset; links/marks are DS components, not raw media.

next/og ImageResponse bitmap (1200x630). No cascade, no DS styles, no tokens at paint time; fixed hex are the dark-sky theme values written as literals, and inline style is the og renderer's only layout API. Not DOM media; excluded from DSImage/ASSET001 by path in ui-check.config.json.
